title: Phoenix Protocol: Verify identity context using STS get-caller-identity (read-only).
concept: STS get-caller-identity retrieves the identity of the caller in a secure and read-only manner, providing essential context for authentication and authorization within cloud infrastructure.
walkthrough:
Execute the AWS CLI command:

aws sts get-caller-identity --output json

This returns the account ID, ARN, and principal type. This command is non-destructive and deterministic.
checkpoints: Returned JSON contains Account, Arn, and UserId
common_mistakes: AWS CLI not authenticated before execution
Expecting resource data instead of identity context
